lines.text: Their birthday is Thursday. You've been staring at the same shop window for ten minutes.

lines.text: The nice edition of the café book. The one with the map inside the cover.

lines.text: Their birthday is Thursday. The nice edition waits in the window.

lines.text: For once you can afford it without checking your balance. You know exactly why.

lines.text: Their birthday is Thursday. Money's been thin since you bagged that envelope.

lines.text: The building's least popular honest person, window-shopping. The glass doesn't care about integrity.

lines.text: Inside, the book smells like the café did that first night.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The map in the cover opens somewhere better. The price tag doesn't.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The clerk pretends not to watch you do math with your face.
